title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account, preferences, and security.

tabDescriptions.account: Manage your name and sign-in email. Your photo, status, and profile details are on your profile page.
tabDescriptions.security: Keep your account protected by changing your password regularly.
tabDescriptions.sessions: Monitor the browsers and devices connected to your ConvoTalk account.
tabDescriptions.appearance: Switch the interface theme for better visual comfort.
tabDescriptions.language: Choose the interface language. Your preference is saved to your account and applied on every device.
tabDescriptions.notifications: Adjust sound alerts, browser notifications, and message counters.
tabDescriptions.blocked: View and manage the list of users blocked from interacting with you.
tabDescriptions.danger: Irreversible actions related to closing and deleting your account.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Adjust the visual theme of your chat interface.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Choose the language ConvoTalk is displayed in. The change applies immediately.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Actions in this area are permanent and cannot be undone.
dangerZone.explanation: Deleting your account permanently removes all your account data, sent messages, media, and conversations from ConvoTalk.

profile.title: Account
profile.description: Manage your name and sign-in email. Your photo, status, and other details are on your profile page.
profile.pendingPrefix: Pending email change: confirm the link sent to
profile.pendingSuffix: . Your current email stays active until confirmation.
profile.emailChangeSuccess: Confirm the new email by clicking the link sent to {{email}}. Your current email stays active until confirmation.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: A confirmation link will be sent to the new email. Your current email stays active until you confirm.

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Keep your account protected with a strong combination of characters.
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Adjust how and when you receive alerts in the app.
notifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. To enable them, allow notifications for this site in your browser options.
notifications.soundDescription: Plays a sound when a new message arrives.
notifications.browserDescription: Get notified about new messages even in the background or with the tab closed.
notifications.badgeDescription: Shows the number of unread messages in the tab title.

sessions.title: Active Sessions
sessions.description: Manage the devices connected to your ConvoTalk account.
sessions.removeAllError: Could not end the other sessions.

blocked.title: Blocked users
blocked.description: Blocked users cannot send you messages or start conversations.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account permanently
deleteAccount.description: This action is irreversible. All your conversations, messages, and media will be permanently deleted from the servers. Enter your password to confirm.
